name: Helesfa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Helesfa: a shield of blue, red and green with a yellow tree, with yellow mantling and a yellow scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Helesfa arms with mantling and scroll
